title: Gad IDE state (.gadide.yaml)
description: IDE layout and editor state for `gad ide`, split out from .gad.yaml. Normally written by the IDE; hand-editing is rarely needed. Values are NOT variable-expanded.

hiddenPanels.description: IDs of panels hidden in the layout.

panels.description: Dockview layout tree (grid, groups, active view).

breakpoints.description: Per-file breakpoint line numbers, keyed by workspace-relative path.
